records.title: Hallo-Live: Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Video Avatar Generation with Asynchronous Dual-Stream and Human-Centric Preference Distillation
records.reason: Hallo-Liveはdual-stream diffusionのstudentをstreaming化し、Future-Expanding Attention、autoregressive audio-video KV cache、few-step DMDを使う。実験は2x H200で20.38 FPS/0.94s、teacher比16x throughput・99.3x lower latencyを報告。ただし対象はtext-conditioned avatar diffusionでありLLM token decode/LLM serving最適化ではない。

records.title: Full-Duplex Interaction in Spoken Dialogue Systems: A Comprehensive Study from the ICASSP 2026 HumDial Challenge
records.reason: full-duplex dialogue challengeのdataset/benchmark構築と評価が主題。要旨はLLM/VLMを利用する可能性を示しても、対象LLM inference compute/memory/latency/throughput/KV-cache/servingを直接改善する手法・評価を示さない。

records.title: X-OPD: Cross-Modal On-Policy Distillation for Capability Alignment in Speech LLMs
records.reason: Speech LLM capability alignmentのon-policy distillation trainingが主題。要旨はLLM/VLMを利用する可能性を示しても、対象LLM inference compute/memory/latency/throughput/KV-cache/servingを直接改善する手法・評価を示さない。

records.title: Retrospective In-Context Learning for Temporal Credit Assignment with Large Language Models
records.reason: self-evolving agentのtemporal credit assignmentとsample-efficient RL trainingが主題。要旨はLLM/VLMを利用する可能性を示しても、対象LLM inference compute/memory/latency/throughput/KV-cache/servingを直接改善する手法・評価を示さない。

records.title: Glance-or-Gaze: Incentivizing LMMs to Adaptively Focus Search via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: GoGはLMMのvisual searchでglobal contextから重要領域を選ぶSelective Gazeを訓練し、主たる評価はsearch/QA benchmark性能とcomplexity-adaptive RL。本文にinput token、encoder FLOPs、latency削減結果はなく、効率より検索精度/能力が主眼。
